candidates.description: This vector activates in response to various common nouns representing tangible objects or abstract concepts.
This vector activates on the letter 'h' and words or subwords starting with 'h' across various scripts and capitalizations.
This vector activates strongly for common male given names and name-like lexical tokens.
This vector activates on proper nouns and adjectives associated with the names of historic landmarks, fictional entities, or popular culture figures.
This vector represents common English derivational suffixes used to form nouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs.
This vector represents the letter 'S' and its various tokenized sub-word forms, including cross-lingual and case-variant representations.
This feature vector activates strongly on common subwords, suffixes, and character sequences found in various proper nouns and multilingual text.
This feature activates on common linguistic suffixes and short phonetic endings across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents concepts related to the Roman Catholic Church and its religious traditions, leadership, and institutions.
This feature vector fires on words ending with the "-all" or "-ell" phonemes and their multilingual or noisy character equivalents.
